notes_for_editor: Record rests on the NHLR entry, a county stub with no history on the Forest Lookouts site, the 2015 Ohio chapter report and the FLO Ohio list. No build date, builder, design, height, staffing or current condition found in pages read. Access not verified. 'Southern Ohio' was removed from the story because the NHLR page does not say it. Unverified lead: a search snippet said the Forest Service calls Shawnee the last lookout on Wayne NF, which would conflict with Lone Pine standing. The FLO list still shows Lone Pine standing and the 2015 report does not mention Lone Pine, so the lead is unresolved and not used in the story. The FLO list text fetched has no check date. Next step: a Wayne National Forest office or the FLO Ohio chapter.
